chess-king: Chess piece that must never be captured
chess-rook: Chess piece that starts in the corners and moves in straight lines
chess-knight: Chess piece that moves in an L shape
chess-pawn: The most numerous chess piece; it can promote
clue-miss-scarlett: The red suspect in Clue, who traditionally moves first
clue-colonel-mustard: The yellow, military suspect in Clue
clue-reverend-green: The clergyman suspect in Clue (a Mr. in the US version)
clue-mrs-peacock: The blue, aristocratic suspect in Clue
clue-professor-plum: The purple, academic suspect in Clue
clue-candlestick: Clue weapon that holds a candle
clue-rope: Clue weapon you could tie a knot in
clue-wrench: Clue weapon from the toolbox for turning bolts
clue-kitchen: Corner room in Clue where meals are cooked
clue-conservatory: Glass-walled corner room in Clue full of plants
clue-dining-room: Clue room with the big table
clue-billiard-room: Clue room with a cue game
clue-lounge: Corner room in Clue for relaxing
clue-hall: Clue room at the front door
clue-study: Corner room in Clue with a desk
monopoly-baltic-avenue: Brown Monopoly property, just before Income Tax
monopoly-vermont-avenue: Middle light-blue Monopoly property, named after a New England state
monopoly-connecticut-avenue: Priciest light-blue Monopoly property, just before Jail
monopoly-st-charles-place: First pink Monopoly property, right after Jail
monopoly-virginia-avenue: Priciest pink Monopoly property, named after a southern state
monopoly-st-james-place: First orange Monopoly property, named after a London square
monopoly-tennessee-avenue: Middle orange Monopoly property, named after a southern state
monopoly-new-york-avenue: Priciest orange Monopoly property, just before Free Parking
monopoly-kentucky-avenue: First red Monopoly property, right after Free Parking
monopoly-indiana-avenue: Middle red Monopoly property, named after a Midwestern state
monopoly-illinois-avenue: Priciest red Monopoly property, a famous Chance card destination
monopoly-atlantic-avenue: First yellow Monopoly property, named after an ocean
monopoly-ventnor-avenue: Middle yellow Monopoly property, named after a New Jersey beach town
monopoly-marvin-gardens: The only yellow Monopoly property that isn't an avenue
monopoly-pacific-avenue: First of the three properties after Go To Jail, named after an ocean
monopoly-north-carolina-avenue: Middle property of the set after Go To Jail, named after a southern state
monopoly-pennsylvania-avenue: Priciest property of the set after Go To Jail; shares its name with the presidential street
monopoly-reading-railroad: The first railroad on the Monopoly board, pronounced "redding"
monopoly-pennsylvania-railroad: Second Monopoly railroad, named after a state
monopoly-b-and-o-railroad: Third Monopoly railroad, named for two Maryland/Ohio cities
monopoly-short-line: The last Monopoly railroad, with the shortest name
monopoly-electric-company: Monopoly utility that powers the lights
monopoly-water-works: Monopoly utility with a faucet icon
